name: Blistered-Tomato Pasta Salad With Basil

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, divided, plus more for drizzling

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the garlic. Tear the basil leaves.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 medium cloves garlic
15 to 20 basil leaves

instructions.primary_message: In a pot of salted boiling water, cook pasta until very tender throughout, 2 to 3 minutes longer than al dente stage according to package. Drain in a colander, then chill under cold running water. Let drain well, then drizzle lightly with olive oil and toss to coat. Set aside.

Meanwhile, in a medium skillet, heat 3 tablespoons olive oil with garlic over medium heat until garlic begins to sizzle lightly. Increase heat to high and add tomatoes. Cook, tossing frequently, until tomato skins split, burst, and release some juices, about 5 minutes; you can gently press on some of the tomatoes with a wooden spoon to help them along, but avoid mashing them. Season with salt and pepper.

In a large bowl, toss pasta with tomatoes, garlic, and their sauce, along with the remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil and basil. Season with salt and pepper. Once cooled, add mozzarella, if using, and toss to combine. Serve at room temperature, adding additional olive oil as necessary to refresh noodles. Pasta salad can be made up to 1 day in advance without basil and kept refrigerated; return to room temperature, toss in basil, and refresh with more olive oil before serving.

schema_metadata.keywords: basil, easy, Italian, pasta, pasta salad, salad, tomato, italian pasta salad recipe

description: Pasta salad gets a thoughtful upgrade by cooking the tomatoes just until bursting so that they release their rich juices into a flavorful sauce. It's an easy make-ahead summertime side dish.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 0.34 kg fresh mozzarella, cut into 1.5-cm cubes (optional)

Optional substitutions: mixed cherry → grape tomatoes
author: Daniel Gritzer
